I told Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-team that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 382 seats.

That figure comes from Tobias's Oct 14 post in that channel, and nothing posted there since then changes it. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so he could already see that post. A seat count also isn't a finance figure, so it's fine to repeat in that channel.
